TV, Smart Tv Repair.description: Our expert technicians handle a wide range of TV issues, from flickering screens to power supply problems. We service LCD, LED, OLED, and Smart TVs to get your entertainment back on track without the cost of a new television.

Wifi Router.description: Experiencing slow internet or frequent connection drops? Our specialists diagnose and repair all types of home and business routers, including mesh systems, ensuring a stable and fast connection.

Plumbing Installation, Repair - Major.description: From leaky pipes to new fixture installations, our professional plumbers manage major plumbing tasks. We provide comprehensive solutions including pipe replacement and drain cleaning to ensure your plumbing system functions flawlessly.

RO Water Purifier.description: Ensure your drinking water is pure and safe. We offer complete service and repair for your RO water purifier, including filter and UV lamp replacement, membrane cleaning, and leak repairs.

Dishwasher.description: Don't let a faulty dishwasher disrupt your routine. Our team addresses common problems like draining issues, leaks, and control panel errors, providing reliable repairs to keep your appliance running efficiently.

Printers / Scanners.description: From paper jams to connectivity problems, we provide swift repair and maintenance for your printers and scanners. Our services include driver installation and software management to ensure seamless operation.

CCTV Installation, Services.description: Secure your property with our professional CCTV installation and maintenance services. We handle everything from camera setup and configuration to wiring inspection, ensuring your surveillance system is reliable and effective.

Batteries / UPS.description: Keep your power backup systems ready for action. We service and repair batteries and UPS units, including diagnostics and terminal cleaning, to ensure you're never left in the dark.

AC Installation, Service.description: Stay cool and comfortable with our expert AC services. We handle repairs for all types of units, including gas refilling, coil cleaning, and fan motor servicing, to ensure optimal cooling performance.

Refrigerator / Fridge Services.description: Is your refrigerator failing to cool or building up frost? Our technicians diagnose and fix a variety of fridge issues, from thermostat repairs to door seal leaks, preserving your food and peace of mind.

Laptop and PC.description: Facing computer troubles? We offer a wide array of services for laptops and PCs, including screen replacement, virus removal, data recovery, and hardware upgrades, to get your device running like new.

Annual Maintenance.description: Sign up for our Annual Maintenance Contract for hassle-free upkeep of your home appliances and systems. We provide scheduled checkups and preventive maintenance to avoid unexpected breakdowns and ensure long-term reliability.

Electrician.description: Our certified electricians provide safe and reliable solutions for all your electrical needs. From fixing switches and sockets to addressing circuit breaker issues, we handle repairs and maintenance with utmost professionalism.

Washing Machine Repair.description: From a washer that won't drain to one that won't start, our technicians are equipped to handle it all. We service top load, front load, and semi-automatic models, providing reliable motor servicing and belt replacements to get your laundry routine back on track.

Electricial Installation.description: Need new wiring or fixtures installed? Our electrical installation service covers everything from setting up new switchboards and sockets to ensuring all connections are safe and up to code, handled by our certified professionals.

Smart Home Installations.description: Transform your house into a smart home with our expert installation services. We set up, configure, and connect your smart lighting, thermostats, and security systems, ensuring seamless integration with your lifestyle.

Lighting Installations.description: Brighten up your space with our professional lighting installation. We handle the secure wiring and mounting of all types of indoor, outdoor, and decorative light fixtures, ensuring a perfect ambiance for your home or office.

Ventillation Installation, Services.description: Improve your indoor air quality with our ventilation services. We install and maintain exhaust fans, kitchen hoods, and HVAC vents, including duct cleaning and motor repairs, to ensure fresh air circulates effectively.

Plumbing Services - Minor.description: For quick and reliable solutions to everyday plumbing issues, our minor repair service is here to help. We handle everything from dripping faucets and leaky pipes to unclogging drains, preventing small problems from becoming big ones.

Drywall repair and maintenance.description: Restore the pristine look of your walls with our drywall repair services. Our team expertly patches holes, repairs cracks, and smoothes surfaces, handling minor touch-up painting to make imperfections disappear.

Minor electrical.description: Have a flickering light or a faulty outlet? Our minor electrical service is perfect for quick fixes. Our electricians can safely handle socket replacements, switch repairs, and other small jobs to keep your home's electricity running smoothly.

Carpentry.description: Our skilled carpenters provide a range of services to repair and enhance your wooden fixtures. From furniture assembly and door hinge repairs to wood polishing, we deliver quality craftsmanship for all your minor carpentry needs.

Solar Panel Installation, Services.description: Harness the power of the sun with our solar panel installation and maintenance services. Our team handles everything from panel setup and inverter servicing to regular cleaning, helping you switch to a sustainable energy source.

Operating System Installation & Upgrade.description: Boost your computer's performance and security with a fresh OS installation or upgrade. We service Windows, macOS, and Linux systems, ensuring a clean setup, system optimization, and installation of essential software.

Antivirus & Security Software Installati.description: Protect your digital life from viruses and malware. We install and configure top-tier antivirus and security software, perform comprehensive scans, and set up firewalls to keep your personal data safe and secure.

Driver Installation & Updates.description: Ensure all your computer's hardware components work flawlessly together. Our technicians handle the installation and updating of essential drivers for printers, graphics cards, and other peripherals, resolving compatibility and performance issues.

Data Backup & Recovery.description: Safeguard your most important files with our data backup and recovery services. We help you set up reliable backup systems, migrate data, and can assist in recovering lost files from storage devices, giving you complete peace of mind.

Printer/Scanner Software Setup.description: Get your printer or scanner working seamlessly with your computer. Our software setup service ensures the correct drivers are installed, your device is connected to the network, and all utilities are configured for hassle-free printing and scanning.

Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC).description: Enjoy year-round peace of mind with our Annual Maintenance Contract. We provide scheduled checkups, preventive maintenance, and minor repairs for your home appliances and systems, helping you avoid costly breakdowns and extend their lifespan.

Appliance Maintenance.description: Keep your essential home appliances in top condition with our routine maintenance service. We clean, service, and perform health checks on your AC, fridge, washing machine, and more to ensure they run efficiently and reliably.

General Home Health Check.description: Proactively care for your home with our General Health Check. Our experts will inspect your home's critical electrical, plumbing, and structural systems to identify and address minor issues before they become major problems.

Roof & Waterproofing Maintenance.description: Protect your home from the elements with our roof and waterproofing maintenance. We specialize in detecting and sealing leaks, repairing cracks, and maintaining waterproofing membranes to prevent water damage and ensure your roof is secure.

Workstation & Furniture Assembly.description: Save time and effort with our professional assembly service. We expertly build and set up your new desks, chairs, and other furniture, ensuring a sturdy and correctly assembled workstation or home furnishing.

Office Electrical Maintenance.description: Ensure your office's electrical systems are safe and reliable. Our maintenance service covers lighting fixtures, switchboards, sockets, and UPS systems, minimizing downtime and keeping your workspace productive.

Networking & IT Setup.description: Establish a robust and efficient network for your office. Our IT setup service includes professional LAN cabling, Wi-Fi configuration, server rack installation, and network troubleshooting to keep your business connected.

Printer & Office Equipment Setup.description: Let us handle the setup of your essential office equipment. We provide complete installation for printers, scanners, and projectors, including driver setup and network configuration, so your team can get to work right away.
